mentions.name: Outfit Genie
mentions.description: A wardrobe and outfit planning mobile app that lets users catalog clothing items with photos, category, color, brand, and tags in a visual closet with a hanging rod and shelves. It tracks items as Clean, Worn, or in the Hamper for laundry management, lets users build and save multi-piece outfits organized by occasion, assign outfits to days of a weekly schedule, and receive AI-generated outfit suggestions powered by DeepSeek with live weather integration. Users can set a style profile with favorite/avoid colors, occasions, and custom styles, and a first-launch onboarding questionnaire seeds the closet with basic wardrobe pieces.
mentions.problem: The author is unorganized and struggles to plan outfits ahead of time while trying to improve their personal style.
mentions.audience: People who want to organize their wardrobe and plan outfits ahead of time, such as style-conscious mobile app users.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on my first solo app, Outfit Genie. I am a really unorganized person and struggle to plan outfits ahead of time. I'm also working on upping my style.
